$comment: scripts/check-route-permissions.py requires every mounted prefix to appear
here with either permission (scope.verb) or exempt_reason + owner.
Undeclared prefixes are tolerated only while listed in
quality/route-permissions-baseline.json; ratchet that file to zero.

/v1/agents.reason: POST/PUT/DELETE and forge/scan mutations gate on agents.write or agents.delete in middleware/auth.py _PROTECTED_OPS; GET listing is authenticated-only.

/v1/audit.reason: POST appends audit rows with an arbitrary actor field; middleware requires audit.write so unscoped callers cannot forge the log.

/v1/auth.reason: Identity bootstrap (session login, logout, OAuth link); unauthenticated entry points are public in public-routes.json; authenticated account-link and profile routes need no task-scoped elevation.

/v1/backlog.reason: Personal planning board scoped to the caller's workspace; reads and writes stay within the member's own backlog rows with no cross-principal mutation.

/v1/canvas.reason: Canvas evaluation surface for the caller's own compositions; routes scope records to the authenticated principal and need no deployment-wide elevation.

/v1/capabilities.reason: Capability discovery and provider configuration POST/PATCH gate on config.write; POST /approvals/* additionally requires approvals.resolve in _PROTECTED_OPS.

/v1/chat.reason: Primary product surface; conversation history and streaming are scoped to the caller's session and workspace membership, with admin role blocked from chat routes in middleware.

/v1/cli.reason: CLI session record only; persists the caller's own terminal session metadata with no cross-principal or host-infrastructure mutation.

/v1/containers.reason: Talks to the Docker socket; POST and DELETE require containers.control in _PROTECTED_OPS.

/v1/credentials.reason: PUT and DELETE mutate stored integration secrets; middleware gates those methods on credentials.write.

/v1/dag-metrics.reason: Read-only node metrics for runs the caller can already inspect; responses are scoped in-route and carry no mutating surface.

/v1/dag-runs.reason: Run inspection is deliberately not elevation-gated; services/dag_run_inspection scopes list/detail/events to the caller's workspace universe and out-of-scope ids 404 (#1174).

/v1/dags.reason: Creating, editing, and running DAGs executes graph nodes including harness kinds; POST/PUT/DELETE gate on dags.write.

/v1/dashboard.reason: Personal UI layout and pinned views; reads and writes affect only the caller's dashboard configuration.

/v1/design.reason: Design content authoring scoped to the caller's workspace; no deployment-wide config or cross-principal mutation.

/v1/evolution.reason: The evolution tournament is the self-improvement loop's other door; GET and POST require rsi.execute.

/v1/eval-judge.reason: Verdict reads and the trigger POST are scoped in-route through the same dag_run_inspection door as /v1/dag-runs; elevation adds no boundary (#1174).

/v1/harness.reason: Starts and steers a coding agent against an operator workdir; GET stream, POST, and DELETE require harness.execute.

/v1/hitl.reason: The pending-work queue and answer route resume graph execution; GET and POST require dags.write (#244).

/v1/install.reason: Bootstrap installer progress for the deployment the caller already authenticated to; no host-infrastructure control beyond the caller's own install session.

/v1/mcp.reason: Discover, test, register and mutate MCP servers; POST/PUT/PATCH gate on mcp.write and DELETE on mcp.delete.

/v1/memory.reason: Personal memory surface; learnings and episodic reads/writes are scoped to the caller's agent/session axes with no cross-principal access.

/v1/messages.reason: Personal notification inbox; list and ack operations affect only the caller's own messages.

/v1/optimizer.reason: Accepting an optimizer proposal rewrites a DAG; POST requires dags.write.

/v1/profile.reason: Caller profile reads and self-service edits; routes mutate only the authenticated principal's own profile fields.

/v1/program.reason: Onboarding coaching state for the caller; progress and dismissals stay within the member's own program record.

/v1/providers.reason: Provider activation stores deployment-wide LLM keys and mutates the global model registry; POST and PUT require config.write.

/v1/quotas.reason: Read-only quota telemetry for the caller's billing cycle; no mutating or cross-principal usage surface.

/v1/rsi.reason: RSI runs push branches and can open PRs; GET and POST require rsi.execute.

/v1/rum.reason: GET /events and /events/summary gate on rum.read in middleware/auth.py _PROTECTED_OPS: the ring is an instance-wide aggregate of every principal's navigation telemetry (route templates, session ids, timings), the same operator-only posture as persona-wide feedback. POST ingest is authenticated-only: the SPA reporter beacons its own bounded, schema-projected timings on the session it already holds, and every user's browser must be able to report without task-scoped elevation (#1420).

/v1/schedules.reason: A schedule is recurring autonomous execution; POST/PUT/DELETE require schedules.write.

/v1/settings.reason: Deployment configuration POST/PUT/PATCH gate on config.write and DELETE on config.delete; GET reads are authenticated-only.

/v1/setup.reason: First-run bootstrap after the public setup entry points; authenticated completion steps mutate only the caller's own account and deployment onboarding state.

/v1/setup-checklist.reason: Personal setup checklist progress; reads and writes affect only the caller's checklist rows.

/v1/skills.reason: Skill registration and PATCH toggles change what future agent runs may do; POST/PATCH gate on skills.write and DELETE on skills.delete.

/v1/tasks.reason: Personal missions and task queue scoped to the caller; no deployment-wide or cross-principal mutation.

/v1/topology.reason: Read-only topology inspection of agents and relationships visible to the caller's workspace membership.

/v1/voice.reason: Device-credential voice intent; authenticated by a per-device secret rather than a session cookie but still caller-scoped with no elevation boundary.

/v1/widgets.reason: Dashboard widget configuration for the caller; reads and writes affect only the member's own widget layout.

/v1/work-items.reason: Personal work-item drafts scoped to the caller's workspace; no cross-principal or host-infrastructure mutation.

/v1/workspaces.reason: Membership, persona authoring, tool bindings and archive/delete gate on workspaces.write; POST /v1/workspaces tab creation is explicitly exempt in middleware.
